description: This file appears to be a utility script for the SuiteCRM installation process. It contains functions for handling language packs, configuration file writing, database setup, security (like .htaccess), and some core setup tasks during installation. The file is a crucial part of the installation and setup utilities for SuiteCRM, providing various helper functions and processing routines.

classes.name: PackageManagerDisplay
classes.description: A class responsible for displaying license information related to language packs and other package management UI components.

methods.name: getLicenseDisplay
methods.description: Delegates to PackageManagerDisplay::getLicenseDisplay to generate the license display HTML for a package.

methods.name: getPackButton
methods.description: Creates an HTML form button for installing, removing, or uninstalling a language pack based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getInstalledLanguages
methods.description: Scans the language directory and returns an array of installed language codes.

methods.name: getInstalledLangPacks
methods.description: Returns an HTML snippet displaying all currently installed language packs with options to uninstall.

methods.name: uninstallLanguagePack
methods.description: Invokes the process to uninstall a language pack.

methods.name: getSugarConfigLanguageArray
methods.description: Returns a string representing the language array entry in the sugar configuration for a given language zip.

calls: Optionally, methods like 'require_once' for external file inclusion, and file operations such as 'unlink', 'copy', 'fwrite', and 'fopen' are invoked frequently.
